Assumptions The assumptions associated with spectroradiometric monitoring approach we have developed can be divided into two categories: assumptions that are inherent to the model and assumptions that are based on the implementation of the technology. With respect to the former category, the primary assumption is that the irradiance incident upon the pond surface is the same as that measured by a cosine-corrected sensor pointed in the upward direction.
